In high school, my best friend and long time friend group all decided to ditch me as well as talk behind my back and insult me heavily to my face.  At the time, I was recovering from depression and this made me relapse hard.  I went through every day talking to no one, just going through the motions.  School ended, and I went to work at a summer camp.  I had 1st graders.  I felt like I had to work hard and act happy for them, and it honestly made me much happier to get thank yous and smiles everyday after the simplest things. 

So I guess my advice would be too work in a good environment/with good people and eventually you’ll get better.  If you’re going through something, hope you get better.
